caseInfo: Parallel importation/counterfeiting of a registered Adour Paris by Fragnance Gate Limited at F05-07 Bauchi Plaza, Tradefair Complex, Ojo, Lagos
product: Parallel importation/counterfeiting of a registered Adour Paris
actionTaken: The facility has been visited for investigation, the complained products were found and mopped up. The management was invited for a consultative meeting and directed to provide a receipt for the purchased or imported documents. At the meeting, the representative did not provide the documents; he was directed to bring the supply/importer to the meeting the following day. The importer accepts the invitation. During the meeting with the importer, he stated that he met the manufacturer during an exhibition tour at Landmark 2024. But no business deal was reached. In the last quarter of 2025, he was recontacted by the manufacturer in Dubai, and they agreed to start the business. He initially ordered 10 cartons of the product for market feasibility. The product was imported into the country through groupage. Neither the details of the business name nor the address were provided by the importer. He claimed the company name was D-Buchi. The company was sanctioned with an administration fine of two million, five hundred thousand naira (2, 500,000) for importing and distributing unregistered products and directed to write a notarized undertaking to desist from such action.
remarks: 1. The facility was visited for investigation and invited to a consultative meeting. 2. The importer of the product was found. 3. The company was sanctioned 2,500,000. 4. Feedback issued

caseInfo: Zoladex injection was purchased from Tonyson pharmacy to treat postate cancer, but the drug failed therapeutic efficacy.
product: Zoladex injection was purchased from Tonyson pharmacy to treat postate cancer, b
actionTaken: The complainant has prostate cancer, with a PSA of around 645ng/dl before initiating treatment with injection. After the treatment, the parameter went down to 0, 2.9, and 4.1 ng/dl. respectively. The increase in the PSA was why the consumer complaint against the drug was that its in effective. The other condition where found to increase the PSA concentration in the body, the patient was enlightened on other possible conditions that may cause the value. The customer was advised to see his doctor for laboratory result review pending any action from our end. The consumer called on 05th May 2026, stating that his physician had reviewed the laboratory result and confirmed that the drug is working, while the slide increase was a result of hormonal change caused by the cancer cells. The complainant was satisfied with the review and withdrew his earlier complaint.
